# Credits and licenses

Horizon M1 is an unofficial build of [Horizon](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon) with native mods compiled in. Full license texts are in this folder (`Horizon-LICENSE.txt`, `GPL-3.0.txt`, `mods/<id>.txt`).

## Horizon

The game client is [Horizon](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon) by Ludovic Marie and the Horizon contributors, licensed under the GNU LGPL v3.0 (`Horizon-LICENSE.txt`, which builds on the GNU GPL v3.0 in `GPL-3.0.txt`). This build is modified. The release also ships the official Horizon launcher app (Horizon.app 0.2.97) from [horizon-rust/horizon releases](https://github.com/horizon-rust/horizon/releases), unmodified.

## Source for this build (LGPL)

The modified Horizon source for the shipped client is:

- upstream Horizon at commit `fdc87aecdbd116bf1e08adcd062fcbaea8c2e2ca`, plus
- the patches listed in [outputs/horizon-native/daily7-stack.txt](https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1/blob/main/outputs/horizon-native/daily7-stack.txt). Each entry is a folder under `outputs/horizon-native/` holding a patch and a NOTES.md.

The client `native-fdc87ae-m1-daily7-73decc0fdc30` is built from these by `outputs/horizon-runtime/build-fast-fdc87ae.py`. Mod sources are pinned in `mods.lock.tsv` at the repo root. Everything is at https://github.com/tm-droid/horizon-m1.

## Disclaimer

Unofficial. Not affiliated with Mojang Studios or Microsoft. This release contains no Minecraft code, textures or sounds: they are prepared on the player's computer from their own Minecraft: Java Edition.
